title: Roblox Hi
blurb: The Roblox 'hi' — the squeaky greeting that echoes across every Roblox lobby ever created. It's friendship at its most efficient: two letters, maximum enthusiasm. Play it when entering any space, digital or physical, to establish immediate wholesome energy. The griefing usually comes later; the hi is always sincere.
origin: The iconic high-pitched greeting from Roblox voice/chat culture.
